messages.author: 05dddafe48e2273c
messages.subject: multipliers to account for repeat visits
parts:
Hi all!

I collected point count data by surveying the same points during 2 periods
within the breeding season across 3 years. To account for these repeat
visits, do I use 2 (within years) or 6 (across all years) as my survey
effort (multiplier)? Density estimates with 6 seem really low!

Thanks,

Jennifer Reidy

messages.author: 5140016d70f6ba82
messages.subject: Re: multipliers to account for repeat visits
parts:
Jennifer-

A friendly reminder to search the listserver before posting. This exact
question was asked and answered last week. The survey multiplier is not
for effort - multiple visits. Use the effort value in the data for
repeat visits. In your case you would use 2 because you visited the
point twice in a year. Then you'll want to estimate density/abundance
for each year and possibly the mean across years.

regards --jeff
